abstract.p: We present our IWSLT 2025 submission for the lowresource track on North Levantine Arabic to English speech translation, build ing on our IWSLT 2024 efforts. We retain last year's cascade ASR architecture that com bines a TDNNF model and a Zipformer for the ASR step. We upgrade the Zipformer to the ZipformerLarge variant (253 M parame ters vs. 66 M) to capture richer acoustic rep resentations. For the MT part, to further allevi ate data sparsity, we created a crowdsourced parallel corpus covering five major Arabic di alects (Tunisian, Levantine, Moroccan, Alge rian, Egyptian) curated via rigorous qualifica tion and filtering. We show that using crowd sourced data is feasible in lowresource scenar ios as we observe improved automatic evalua tion metrics across all dialects. We also experi mented with the dataset under a highresource scenario, where we had access to a large, high quality Levantine Arabic corpus from LDC. In this setting, adding the crowdsourced data does not improve the scores on the official validation set anymore. Our final submission scores 20.0 BLEU on the official test set.
